## Exercise A.1

## Exercise A.2
Write a function that takes a numeric vector x and a threshold value h as arguments and returns the vector of all values in x greater than h. Test the function on seq(0, 1, 0.1) with threshold 0.3. Have the example from Exercise A.1 in mind
